intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: Welcome! We care about your privacy and want you to understand how we handle your information in this non-commercial educational project. This policy explains everything in simple terms. By playing Uzbek Wars, you're trusting us with your data, and we take that seriously. As a personal learning initiative and portfolio project, we follow standard practices for educational platforms while being transparent about our data handling.

dataCollection.title: 1. Information We Collect
dataCollection.intro: To provide you with a personalized gaming experience in this educational project, we collect:
dataCollection.item1: Basic account information when you sign in, helping us recognize you and keep your progress safe.
dataCollection.item2: Your game progress and achievements, so you can pick up right where you left off.
dataCollection.item3: Technical information that helps us optimize performance for your device and learn about usage patterns.
dataCollection.item4: Preferences and settings to remember how you like to play.
dataCollection.item5: Referral connections when you invite friends, so we can reward you both.
dataCollection.item6: Standard web analytics to help improve this educational project.

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.item1: Delivering a smooth and enjoyable gaming experience tailored to you.
dataUsage.item2: Keeping your account secure and your progress saved.
dataUsage.item3: Understanding how to make this educational project better based on how people play.
dataUsage.item4: Continuously improving performance and adding features as part of the learning process.
dataUsage.item5: Analyzing usage patterns for educational purposes and project development.

dataSharing.title: 3. Data Sharing and Third Parties
dataSharing.text: As a non-commercial educational project, we work with various third-party service providers to deliver features (authentication, hosting, analytics, payment processing, etc.). These partners operate independently with their own policies. We may share necessary data with these services to provide functionality. We may also analyze aggregated, anonymized data for educational purposes and project improvement. As with any online platform, we may need to comply with legal requirements if necessary.

thirdParty.title: 4. Our Trusted Partners
thirdParty.intro: To provide you with a seamless experience in this educational project, we work with various technology partners:
thirdParty.google: For secure and convenient authentication, making it easy for you to access your account.
thirdParty.telegram: For optional community communication and support when you need us. We may use other services as needed for this non-commercial project.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Keeping Your Data Safe
dataSecurity.text: Your security is important to us. As a personal educational project, we use industry-standard practices and trusted service providers to protect your information. While we implement robust security measures and work with reputable partners, we want you to be aware that no online service can guarantee 100% security - this is true for all internet services, especially personal non-commercial projects. We continuously monitor and update our security practices within the scope of this educational initiative to keep your data as safe as possible.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and Storage
cookies.text: We use standard web technologies like cookies and local storage to remember your preferences and keep you logged in. This is how most modern websites work and helps provide you with a seamless experience. You can adjust your browser settings if you prefer, though some features may not work as smoothly without them. This is standard practice for web applications and educational projects.

userRights.title: 7. Your Control
userRights.item1: You can view your game data anytime through your profile.
userRights.item2: If you ever want to leave, you can request account deletion by contacting us.
userRights.item3: Update your character name and preferences whenever you like.
userRights.item4: Request a copy of your game data if you need it. As a non-commercial project, we'll do our best to accommodate requests.

dataRetention.title: 8. Data Storage
dataRetention.text: We keep your data as long as you're actively playing to preserve your progress and achievements. If an account hasn't been used for an extended period (around 12 months), we may archive or remove it to keep our systems running efficiently. This is standard practice for online gaming platforms and helps maintain this personal educational project sustainably.

children.title: 9. Age-Appropriate Gaming
children.text: Our service is designed for players aged 13 and older. We don't knowingly collect information from younger children. If you're a parent and have concerns, please reach out to us.

changes.title: 10. Policy Updates
changes.text: As this educational project grows and evolves, we may update this policy to reflect new features, learning experiences, or practices. We'll post any changes here, and your continued use means you're comfortable with the updates. We're committed to transparency about how we handle your information in this non-commercial learning initiative.
